primary_gt.interpretation: Largest later Nepal EQ alert occurred about 17.0 days after the Gorkha mainshock.

criteria.description: Uses the Gorkha mainshock record with id us20002926 and timestamp 2015-04-25T06:11:25.950000Z.
criteria.name: mainshock_timestamp

criteria.description: Filters Nepal EQ disaster-alert records to those more than one minute after the mainshock, yielding six later alerts.
criteria.name: later_alert_filter

criteria.description: Uses the later Nepal alert with the largest severity value, M7.3 at 2015-05-12T07:05:19Z.
criteria.name: largest_alert_rule

criteria.description: Computes (later alert timestamp minus mainshock timestamp) divided by 86,400 seconds, giving 17.037420 days before rounding.
criteria.name: elapsed_day_formula

criteria.description: Returns elapsed_days_to_largest_later_alert_rounded as 17.0 days in the requested JSON field with a short timing interpretation.
criteria.name: requested_json_and_rounding
